title: Army Interplanetary Phenomenon Unit confirmed to Steinman

tellings.quote: Yeah, 47 to 50. And I that was first confirmed in 1986 to UFO researcher William Steinman.

plain: The US Army is said to have run a small team called the Interplanetary Phenomenon Unit from 1947 to 1950 to look into UFOs. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells Michels the unit's existence "was first confirmed in 1986 to UFO researcher William Steinman," and points to papers he calls the unit's report and a field order. If true, it would mean the Army had its own UFO investigators from the very start of the modern UFO era.
